review: Cockroach. Literally, he is very tanky although in the form of constant self healing which may cause him to be staggered considering low defensive stats. At least getting back HP is not hard. His s3 is kind of weird since he barely has any rupture count application so all he can do is just damage and self heal. Like almost every gregor IDs his support passive is really good allowing you to heal every turn this time in the form of gluttony and it is better than the others if said sinners have 2 slots.
